snippet.title: Gloombo 🌱 Official Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Gloombo on Steam 💛
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4992720/Gloombo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

A little company while you work 🌿

Gloombo is a desktop companion who lives on a floating island and crafts while you focus. Pick something to craft, start a Focus session, and get on with your own task while Gloombo works alongside you.

When it’s time for a break, decorate with the finished items, tidy up the island, read letters from friends in nearby lands, or hang out with the cat. Move and resize the island to keep Gloombo nearby while you work or study.

Orders don’t have deadlines, and friendships don’t fade while you’re away. Your little island will be waiting whenever you need a break :)

We’re a husband-and-wife team making our first game together. We’re aiming to have a demo ready before the next Steam Next Fest and take part, with Early Access planned afterwards, before the end of the year.

We’d love to hear what you think in the comments!

Find us on social media: @playgloombo

#Gloombo #CozyGames #IndieGames
